brd_json.Executive Summary: Audited compliance governance for EU AI Act (High-Risk Classification avoidance), US FTC automated algorithmic liability, and SOC2 Type II automated logging.
brd_json.Problem & Opportunity: Enterprises handling financial or patient data risk statutory fines if third-party AI models process code without formal Data Processing Agreements (DPA) and GDPR Article 28 validation.
brd_json.Technical Architecture: Immutable tamper-proof audit trails logged to Google BigQuery `brd_runs` with SHA-256 commit hashes, user approvals, and zero training on customer IP clauses.
brd_json.Go-to-Market Strategy: Target enterprise compliance officers with pre-certified DPA agreements, ISO 27001 mappings, and HIPAA Business Associate Agreements (BAA).
brd_json.Regulatory & Compliance Risk: Critical liability: If the AI bot approves vulnerable code that leads to a production data breach, disclaimers and explicit 'human-in-the-loop' signoffs must be contractually enforced.
brd_json.Financial Plan & Unit Economics: Allocate $20,000 for external SOC2 Type II audit and legal DPA certification during seed stage.

raw_text: The Regulator assessment mandates verifiable audit logs, clear human-in-the-loop liability boundaries, and GDPR-compliant DPAs.
